resolution: STMT-GOD-NAMES-NO-BEING-WF-P1, STMT-GRAMMAR-FIXES-REFERENCE and STMT-FIDEIST-REFERENCE-BUNDLE-FAILS-FOR-CATHOLIC-PRACTICE use the practice-use sense (DEF-NAME-REFERS-IN-PRACTICE). The nominal-definition leaves (STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-FULLY-DESCRIBED-PRINCIPLE, STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-UNIQUE-MAXIME-ENS, STMT-UNIQUE-PURE-ACT-FIRST-MOVER-IS-GOD) use the proper sense (DEF-GOD-NOMINAL-Q13). The link theorems noBeingExcludesFullDescription and noBeingExcludesUniquePureActFirstMover instantiate the leaves' predicate with the practice-use reference only as a schema: the rival relations on the leaves therefore hold under the open identification of the two senses, which no record asserts. No argument passes from one sense to the other.
